question: Which river from the following originates from the Amarkantak Plateau?
solution: The correct answer is __**Narmada**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **Narmada River** originates from the **Amarkantak Plateau**, which is located in the state of **Madhya Pradesh**, India. It is one of the major rivers in the country. • The Narmada is also known as the **"Lifeline of Madhya Pradesh and Gujarat"** as it provides water for irrigation, drinking, and hydroelectric power generation. • It flows through a **rift valley** between the Vindhya and Satpura mountain ranges, which is a unique geographical feature of this river. • The Narmada River ultimately drains into the **Arabian Sea**, covering a distance of approximately **1,312 kilometers**. • Notably, the Narmada is considered one of the **seven sacred rivers** in Hinduism, and many temples and pilgrimage sites are located along its banks.
